identity.name: Sports Medicine - Open
identity.source_note: Platform migration: sportsmedicine-open.springeropen.com now 301-redirects to the Springer Nature Link platform at https://link.springer.com/journal/40798/submission-guidelines (same publisher, Springer Nature/SpringerOpen OA). Plain WebFetch of the live URL 303-redirects to an idp.springer.com cookie-authorize shell, so the guide was encoded from the live current page rendered in a headless browser (not an archive). Cron should treat this journal as needing headless fetch.

encoding_notes: Publisher/platform migration: sportsmedicine-open.springeropen.com 301-redirects to link.springer.com/journal/40798 (Springer Nature Link). Same publisher (Springer Nature / SpringerOpen OA), new hosting platform; live current content read via headless browser (plain fetch hits an idp.springer.com cookie shell).

Article-type mapping: Original Research Articles->original_research; Review Articles->review; Systematic Reviews->systematic_review; Letters to the Editor->letter; Current Opinions->editorial (guide describes it as 'more editorial in nature').
Omitted with no clean enum slot: Short Communications (brief research report ~ original_research) and Leading Articles (state-of-the-art review ~ review) would both collide with existing keys.

Abstract structure varies by type: original_research=Background/Results/Conclusions; systematic_review=Background/Methods/Results/Conclusions/Registration; review=loosely structured background/main-body/short-conclusion (non-structured allowed for narrative review). abstract.sections encoded for the primary type (original_research). All types share the 350-word abstract cap.

references.et_al_threshold=6 is DERIVED from the guide's reference EXAMPLE which lists 6 authors then 'et al.' (SpringerOpen Vancouver 'first 6 then et al'), not from an explicit numeric rule sentence.

references.in_text=bracket: guide states a numbered Vancouver style ('reference number') but does not explicitly show bracket vs superscript; bracket is the SpringerOpen rendering (low-risk assumption).

layout: 'Use double line spacing' and 'Include line and page numbering' are the only explicit rules -> line_spacing=double, page_numbers.show=true, line_numbers=continuous (continuous-vs-per-page not explicitly stated). No font family/size, margins, alignment, indent, or page size prescribed (tables reference 'A4 or Letter', both accepted -> page_size=null).

Figures: guide also accepts Word/PowerPoint/BMP/CDX (not in schema enum); encoded only eps/pdf/tiff/jpeg/png. ~300 dpi at final size; figure titles(<=15 words) + legends(<=300 words) go in the main manuscript, not in the graphic file; individual figure files uploaded separately, max 10 MB each.

Declarations (all required under a 'Declarations' heading, 'Not applicable' if irrelevant): Ethics approval and consent to participate, Consent for publication, Availability of data and materials, Competing interests, Funding, Authors' contributions, Acknowledgements, Authors' information (optional). 'Authors' information' has no schema slot; trial_registration appears as an abstract/SR field, not a standalone declaration, so it is not encoded here.
Key Points table (~3 stand-alone statements placed after the Abstract) is required for research/review/SR/short-comm/opinion types -> misc.highlights_required=true.
Peer review is single-anonymous (reviewers see author identities) -> double_blind=false; no separate blinded/anonymized title-page file required.
Letters to the Editor: <=500-word body, no abstract, must begin with 'To the Editor'. Not encoded (no schema field): APC (GBP 2990 / USD 4390 / EUR 3390) and licence options CC BY-NC-ND or CC BY.
